CREATE TABLE "public"."automation_audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "path" text NOT NULL,
  "request_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "resource_id" uuid,
  "resource_type" text NOT NULL,
  "result" text NOT NULL,
  "scope" text NOT NULL,
  "status_code" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "automation_audit_logs_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "automation_audit_logs_action_check" CHECK ((action = ANY (ARRAY['create'::text, 'update'::text, 'publish'::text, 'unpublish'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "automation_audit_logs_resource_type_check" CHECK ((resource_type = ANY (ARRAY['content'::text, 'quiz'::text, 'pub'::text, 'tag'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "automation_audit_logs_result_check" CHECK ((result = ANY (ARRAY['success'::text, 'failure'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "automation_audit_logs_status_code_check" CHECK (((status_code >= 100) AND (status_code <= 599)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."automation_idempotency_keys" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT ((now() + '24:00:00'::interval)) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "key_hash" character(64) NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "path" text NOT NULL,
  "request_hash" character(64) NOT NULL,
  "resource_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "resource_type" text NOT NULL,
  "response_body" jsonb,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "status_code" int4,
  CONSTRAINT "automation_idempotency_keys_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "automation_idempotency_keys_resource_type_check" CHECK ((resource_type = ANY (ARRAY['content'::text, 'quiz'::text, 'pub'::text, 'tag'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "automation_idempotency_keys_status_check" CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'completed'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "automation_idempotency_response_check" CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND (status_code IS NULL) AND (response_body IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'completed'::text) AND ((status_code >= 200) AND (status_code <= 299)) AND (response_body IS NOT NULL))))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."calendar_event_translations" (
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "event_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "calendar_event_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "calendar_event_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."calendar_events" (
  "aliases" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "category" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date_rule" jsonb,
  "featured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_public_holiday" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "source" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "calendar_events_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "calendar_events_category_check" CHECK (((category IS NULL) OR (category = ANY (ARRAY['public_holiday'::text, 'culture'::text, 'tradition'::text, 'language'::text, 'literature'::text, 'history'::text, 'religion'::text])))),
  CONSTRAINT "calendar_events_date_rule_check" CHECK (((date_rule IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(date_rule) = 'object'::text) AND (date_rule ? 'type'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((date_rule -> 'type'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((date_rule ->> 'type'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['fixed'::text, 'date_range'::text, 'nth_weekday'::text, 'last_weekday'::text, 'relative_to_easter'::text, 'weekday_on_or_after'::text, 'closest_weekday_to_date'::text, 'rule_set'::text, 'annual_variable'::text]))))),
  CONSTRAINT "calendar_events_sort_order_check" CHECK ((sort_order >= 0))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."content_entries" (
  "category" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hero_image_asset_id" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "kind" text,
  "published_at" timestamptz(6),
  "slug" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "content_entries_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "content_entries_category_check" CHECK ((btrim(category) <> ''::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "content_entries_kind_check" CHECK ((btrim(kind) <> ''::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "content_entries_publication_state_check" CHECK ((((status = 'draft'::text) AND (published_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'published'::text) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL)))),
  CONSTRAINT "content_entries_slug_check" CHECK ((btrim(slug) <> ''::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "content_entries_status_check" CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'published'::text])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."content_translations" (
  "body_markdown" text NOT NULL,
  "content_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "hero_image_alt" text DEFAULT (''::text) NOT NULL,
  "hero_image_caption" text DEFAULT (''::text) NOT NULL,
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "summary" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "content_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("content_id", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "content_translations_hero_image_alt_length_check" CHECK ((char_length(hero_image_alt) <= 500)),
  CONSTRAINT "content_translations_hero_image_caption_length_check" CHECK ((char_length(hero_image_caption) <= 1000)),
  CONSTRAINT "content_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."media_assets" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "file_size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "height" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "mime_type" text NOT NULL,
  "storage_key" text NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  "width" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "media_assets_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "media_assets_file_size_check" CHECK (((file_size >= 1) AND (file_size <= 4194304))),
  CONSTRAINT "media_assets_height_check" CHECK (((height >= 1) AND (height <= 8192))),
  CONSTRAINT "media_assets_mime_type_check" CHECK ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['image/jpeg'::text, 'image/png'::text, 'image/webp'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "media_assets_pixel_count_check" CHECK ((((width)::bigint * (height)::bigint) <= 40000000)),
  CONSTRAINT "media_assets_storage_key_check" CHECK (((btrim(storage_key) <> ''::text) AND (storage_key = btrim(storage_key)))),
  CONSTRAINT "media_assets_url_check" CHECK (((btrim(url) <> ''::text) AND (url = btrim(url)))),
  CONSTRAINT "media_assets_width_check" CHECK (((width >= 1) AND (width <= 8192)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."municipality_codes" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "prefecture_code" int2 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "municipality_codes_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("code"),
  CONSTRAINT "municipality_codes_code_check" CHECK ((code ~ '^[0-9]{6}$'::text))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."municipality_translations" (
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "municipality_code" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "name_reading" text,
  CONSTRAINT "municipality_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("municipality_code", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "municipality_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "municipality_translations_name_check" CHECK ((btrim(name) <> ''::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "municipality_translations_name_reading_check" CHECK (((name_reading IS NULL) OR (btrim(name_reading) <> ''::text)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."prefecture_translations" (
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "name_reading" text,
  "prefecture_code" int2 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "prefecture_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("prefecture_code", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "prefecture_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "prefecture_translations_name_check" CHECK ((btrim(name) <> ''::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "prefecture_translations_name_reading_check" CHECK (((name_reading IS NULL) OR (btrim(name_reading) <> ''::text)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."prefectures" (
  "code" int2 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "prefectures_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("code"),
  CONSTRAINT "prefectures_code_check" CHECK (((code >= 1) AND (code <= 47)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pub_status_translations" (
  "display_name" text NOT NULL,
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "status_code" int2 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "pub_status_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("status_code", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "pub_status_translations_display_name_check" CHECK ((btrim(display_name) <> ''::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "pub_status_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pub_statuses" (
  "code" int2 NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "pub_statuses_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("code")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pub_tags" (
  "pub_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "tag_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "pub_tags_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("pub_id", "tag_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pub_translations" (
  "address" text,
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "name_reading" text,
  "pub_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "pub_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("pub_id", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "pub_translations_address_check" CHECK (((address IS NULL) OR (btrim(address) <> ''::text))),
  CONSTRAINT "pub_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "pub_translations_name_check" CHECK ((btrim(name) <> ''::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "pub_translations_name_reading_check" CHECK (((name_reading IS NULL) OR (btrim(name_reading) <> ''::text)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pub_type_translations" (
  "display_name" text NOT NULL,
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "pub_type_code" int2 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "pub_type_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("pub_type_code", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "pub_type_translations_display_name_check" CHECK ((btrim(display_name) <> ''::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "pub_type_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pub_types" (
  "code" int2 NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "pub_types_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("code"),
  CONSTRAINT "pub_types_key_check" CHECK ((key = ANY (ARRAY['irish'::text, 'british'::text, 'other'::text, 'unclassified'::text])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pubs" (
  "google_maps_url" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "instagram_url" text,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8,
  "longitude" float8,
  "municipality_code" text,
  "prefecture_code" int2,
  "pub_type_code" int2,
  "status_code" int2,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "website_url" text,
  CONSTRAINT "pubs_columns_new_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pubs_columns_new_google_maps_url_check" CHECK (((google_maps_url IS NULL) OR (google_maps_url ~* '^https?://'::text))),
  CONSTRAINT "pubs_columns_new_instagram_url_check" CHECK (((instagram_url IS NULL) OR (instagram_url ~* '^https?://'::text))),
  CONSTRAINT "pubs_columns_new_latitude_check" CHECK (((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::double precision) AND (latitude <= (90)::double precision))),
  CONSTRAINT "pubs_columns_new_longitude_check" CHECK (((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::double precision) AND (longitude <= (180)::double precision))),
  CONSTRAINT "pubs_columns_new_website_url_check" CHECK (((website_url IS NULL) OR (website_url ~* '^https?://'::text)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."quiz_choice_translations" (
  "choice_id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "question_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_choice_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("question_id", "choice_id", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_choice_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."quiz_choices" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "question_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_choices_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("question_id", "id"),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_choices_id_check" CHECK ((btrim(id) <> ''::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_choices_sort_order_check" CHECK ((sort_order >= 0))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."quiz_question_translations" (
  "explanation" text NOT NULL,
  "image_alt" text DEFAULT (''::text) NOT NULL,
  "image_caption" text DEFAULT (''::text) NOT NULL,
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "question" text NOT NULL,
  "question_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "source_label" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_question_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("question_id", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_question_translations_image_alt_length_check" CHECK ((char_length(image_alt) <= 500)),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_question_translations_image_caption_length_check" CHECK ((char_length(image_caption) <= 1000)),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_question_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."quiz_questions" (
  "category" text,
  "correct_choice_id" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_asset_id" uuid,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "related_content_id" uuid,
  "source_url" text,
  "special_day" int2,
  "special_month" int2,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_questions_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_questions_category_check" CHECK (((category IS NULL) OR (btrim(category) <> ''::text))),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_questions_correct_choice_id_check" CHECK (((correct_choice_id IS NULL) OR (btrim(correct_choice_id) <> ''::text))),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_questions_source_url_check" CHECK (((source_url IS NULL) OR (btrim(source_url) <> ''::text))),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_questions_special_date_check" CHECK ((((special_month IS NULL) = (special_day IS NULL)) AND ((special_month IS NULL) OR (((special_month >= 1) AND (special_month <= 12)) AND ((special_day >= 1) AND (special_day <=
CASE
    WHEN (special_month = 2) THEN 29
    WHEN (special_month = ANY (ARRAY[4, 6, 9, 11])) THEN 30
    ELSE 31
END))))))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tag_translations" (
  "locale" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tag_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "tag_translations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("tag_id", "locale"),
  CONSTRAINT "tag_translations_locale_check" CHECK ((locale = ANY (ARRAY['ja'::text, 'en'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "tag_translations_name_check" CHECK ((btrim(name) <> ''::text))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tags" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "tags_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
